verdict.rationale: WooCommerce exposes its store data through several programmatic surfaces. The REST API offers full create/read/update/delete over WC data with scoped keys and official JS/PHP/Python/Ruby libraries. The Store API covers cart, checkout and products. There is also an official WC-CLI, native MCP support for AI assistants, and webhooks. Together these cover the core admin and storefront operations an AI-native user would drive from the UI. missing for 10: an explicit documented statement of UI-to-API parity, evidence that setup, theme and extension settings can be managed via the API, a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
